svg.title: Flare SM70 decode-only headline
svg.desc: Decode-only, Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, package f21b9abb on server binary 48b69ed4, memory limit 31G, public prompts of 578 to 582 tokens, 2026-10-24: median decode 83.2 tok/s at 1 agent and 64.9 tok/s per agent at 4 agents. Previous package fd7c24dc on release binary d4ffb1fa, 2026-10-23: 83.0 and 64.8. Best recorded: 90.4 tok/s at 1 agent and 70.7 per agent at 4 on 2026-10-22 with the older binary 2c792073 and internal prompts. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
